protocol.issue_body_status: No description provided when actually read through Edge on 2026-10-23
protocol.factor: R5=C_adj[t]/C_adj[t-5]-1; main score=-R5; full six-row historical price path
protocol.target: O_adj[t+1+h]/O_adj[t+1]-1; entry/exit in period, signal may precede start; full open/factor path
protocol.direction: Fixed reversal interpretation from previous exercise; raw R5 signs also disclosed, no new direction selection
protocol.HAC: Information Bartlett L=max(5,h), finite-observation n/(n-1) correction; h5 L10/L20 sensitivities. Portfolio paired/relative-alpha L5, no small-sample correction. Both normal approximate, raw two-sided P only.
protocol.missingness: Keep source-date positions; no per-stock valid-date compression; boundary censoring distinct from in-period missing labels. Sorting/groups use signal-known data before observing labels.
protocol.combination: Same four-component past-finite pool; P3=equal ranks(momentum20,lowvol20,liquidity20); P4=equal ranks(same three,-R5); original weights also change.
protocol.increment: IR(P4-P3) and net Sharpe difference; not a common-benchmark delta-IR. Alpha means intercept of daily net rP4 on rP3, not CAPM/official risk alpha.
boundaries: All periods previously observed; no untouched out-of-sample claim.
Historical ST truth unavailable; price_proxy is not accurate ST exclusion.
Daily OHLC/amount and action rejection are post-session audits, not opening-auction feasibility proof.
Decile Q10-Q1 is an overlapping-window gross diagnostic, not an executable short portfolio.
Synthetic total-return units do not establish physical dividend/share settlement.
Industry, capitalization, official risk factors, investable index and cash interest are not available.
Fixed wind-down20 is inherited from earlier retrospective exit repair; no new parameter optimization.
No external posting/upload is performed by this program.
protocol.failure_policy: Record failed information cohort or execution scenario and continue remaining jobs.
protocol.reuse_scope: Only completed aggregate information cohorts with unchanged input/metrics code. Execution is newly run after queue-guard repair.

method.signal: signed 5DR=-R5; raw R5 ICs are algebraic sign reversals, not independent tests
method.target: O_adj[t+1+h]/O_adj[t+1]-1; full positive finite open/cumadj path
method.groups: past eligible finite signal pool; ascending score, symbol tie-break; array_split into 10 fixed groups
method.percentile: average rank minus 0.5 divided by past pool size
method.inference: source-grid Bartlett HAC, normal approximate 95% CI and raw two-sided P; min 20 finite days
method.conditional: association controlling only momentum20, lowvol20, liquidity20 ranks; no industry or size controls
method.spread: gross Q10-Q1 diagnostic, not shorting profits; no overlapping-return compounded NAV
method.period_status: all periods previously observed; no untouched out-of-sample claim

protocol.base_combo: equal percentile ranks momentum20 (no skip), lowvol20, liquidity20
protocol.added_combo: four equal percentile ranks including -R5; common legal finite four-component pool; P3-to-P4 also changes original component weights, not a pure marginal addition
protocol.double_cost_semantics: old simulator cost_multiplier=2 doubles commission/minimum, stamp, transfer and slippage; tick rounding may prevent exact realized doubling
boundaries: Daily-bar model assumptions do not prove opening liquidity or auction fills.
price_proxy is not verified historical ST exclusion.
Writeoffs are losses, not trading exits.
Synthetic total-return units are not physical settlement shares.

scope: All 36 persisted information cohorts: daily calendars/counts/group identities, aggregate and monthly mean/std/HAC/CI/raw P including source-grid gaps.
All 20 persisted execution daily ledgers: 13 performance metrics, returns, cash and terminal/writeoff semantics; six paired return/relative-alpha calculations.
Original ZIP independent factor/target/IC/ranks/groups/OLS recomputation on first/middle/last valid target dates of 2025 all_liquid h5 only.
Exact roundtrip daily ledger continuity with preserved 2025 V4 5DR baseline; code and ZIP hash identity.
independent_validation.source_sample_price_construction: Independent raw_price * (cumadj / first_valid_positive_cumadj), preserving declared causal normalization and IEEE operation order; no algebraic cancellation before ranks.
limitations: No full stock-day independent information recalculation; conditional beta verified as persisted daily series and inference only.
Source sample eligibility reuses preserved old Market.eligible; factor and target formulas independently recomputed.
No independent full per-trade cash/position/price/fee/capacity reconstruction; daily-ledger verification does not prove ledger generation or real execution.
No claim of untouched out-of-sample data, actual historical ST exclusion, opening-auction feasibility or physical share settlement.

normalization_investigation.correction: Validator previously used raw*cumadj; repaired to independently compute declared raw*(cumadj/first_valid_factor). No computation, data, saved statistics, or tolerance changes.
